Three independent agent.md gates fail at HEAD 28f7942: (a) fcc-auditor A-001 is a BLOCKER on regulatory-correctness surfaces (OET-65 / §17.4 sections never rendered) and the agent recommends BLOCK; (b) devsecops last-report.md is 0 bytes and last-findings.json does not exist, so crash_loop / secrets_changed / migration_without_rollback cannot be evaluated; (c) deploy-history.json shows last_good_sha=null — there is no rollback target, itself a safe-deploy precondition. findings.title: agent-loop-stalled — pipeline persistence still 7/9 broken at HEAD 28f7942 (3rd cycle); META-001 code shipped but harness Write allowlist not widened, devsecops persisted 0-byte audit
findings.recommended_fix: Two-part fix mirroring technical-pmp PMP-001. (a) Add a persistent allowlist in agents/settings.json: Write(/opt/itmlogic/agents/**) plus Write(/opt/itmlogic/agents/state/**) and Write(/opt/itmlogic/agents/reports/**). (b) Add a fail-loud post-condition to agents/scripts/run-agent.sh: exit non-zero when agents/<agent>/last-findings.json is absent or has a stale head_sha at end of run. File GitHub issue tagged agent-loop-stalled; loop halts until human acknowledges.
tests_required: ls agents/*/last-findings.json after a full run-all-agents.sh cycle — all 10 must exist
for f in agents/*/last-findings.json; do node agents/scripts/validate-findings-json.js "$f"; done (all must exit 0)
jq '.head_sha' agents/*/last-findings.json | sort -u (must yield exactly one SHA, equal to git rev-parse HEAD)
bash agents/scripts/run-agent.sh devsecops-agent — must exit non-zero when last-findings.json missing
